newsitem.title: FINLAND: ORION TRACKS GAINS IN SWEDISH ASTRA.
newsitem.headline: ORION TRACKS GAINS IN SWEDISH ASTRA.

text.p: Shares in Finnish pharmaceuticals group Orion Oy rose in lively trade on Thursday as rumours that Investor Ab had sold its stake in Swedish Astra sparked interest in Nordic pharmaceuticals stocks, brokers said.

At 1325/1125 GMT, Orion's more traded B share stood at 162.00 markka, up 4.50 markka or almost three percent, after hitting 163.00 markka -- its highest since June 19. Trade was a lively 12 million markka.
There was both domestic and overseas demand for Orion, brokers said.
Shares in Astra rose over three percent earlier on the rumours that Investor AB had sold its 10 percent stake in it. Investor declined to comment.
Orion was not expected to be linked to the rumoured deal.
Finnish medical equipment maker Instrumentarium's B share was up 2.00 markka at a new calendar year high 172.00, but trade was thin.
